blocks.x: Testing & Quality Engineering from Achala IT Solutions: advisory that ends in a delivered system. The team that recommends is the team that builds — one two-week diagnostic, one signed baseline, delivery under the same gates as every Achala expertise domain.

Testing & Quality Engineering runs on a fixed rhythm at Achala: a two-week diagnostic that makes the cost visible, a baseline both sides sign, and delivery through the same evidence gates as our platform programs. No advice without ownership of the outcome.

For AI systems, testing extends beyond deterministic checks: evaluation sets with human-labeled ground truth, adversarial suites, drift monitors and bias probes become part of the same gate machinery. The output is a quality signal leadership can read, escape rate, coverage of risk, time-to-feedback, rather than a pass percentage nobody trusts.
